test_title: PYST 54: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined group of words.

Since God is __an all-powerful__ creator, he has absolute control over those whom he has created.
solution:
The correct answer is Option (2) i.e.** 'Omnipotent'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"an all-powerful" **creator: (सर्वशक्तिमान सृष्टिकर्ता)
 
• **Omnipotent**: (सर्वशक्तिमान) - (Having unlimited power; able to do anything)
 
 
• **Example**: Believers see their deity as omnipotent and benevolent.
 
 
 
• Omnipotent perfectly describes "an all-powerful" creator, as it denotes having all power.

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Omnipotent'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Voracious**: (भूखा) - Having a huge appetite

 
 
• **Example**: He was a voracious reader, devouring books one after another.
 
 
 
• **Incorrigible**: (सुधार न सकने योग्य) - Not able to be corrected or reformed
 
 
• **Example**: Despite repeated punishments, the boy remained incorrigible.
 
 
 
• **Omniscient**: (सर्वज्ञ) - Knowing everything
 
 
• **Example**: In many stories, the narrator is presented as being omniscient.
